register.labelZh: CARRY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: carry on 可以表示繼續進行某項活動;carry something on 則可以表示延續傳統或工作。；carry somebody back 可以表示聲音、氣味或照片令人回想起過去;carry somebodythrough 則表示支持、信心或決心幫助某人度過難關。；carry along、carry away 和 carry off 可以描述水流、風或其他力量如何移動某人或某物。；你可以 carry out 一項計劃、carry it through 至完成,或在有需要時把它 carry over至較後時間。；同一個表達可以表示因疾病死亡、某物被帶走,或贏得獎項。
register.summaryEn: Carry on can describe continuing an activity, while carry something on can describe keeping a tradition or project alive. Carry somebody back connects a present sound, smell or picture with a past memory. Carry somebody through shows how support, confidence or determination helps someone continue. Carry along, carry away and carry off can show how a natural force moves a person or object. You can carry out a plan, carry it through to the end, or carry it over when it must be delayed. The same expression can describe being killed by an illness, having something taken away or winning a prize.
